title: 약해지는 ㅎ: 은행, 전화, 결혼
objective: By the end, you can read words like 은행, 전화, and 결혼 with a weak ㅎ, and tell when ㅎ stays strong.
summary: In everyday speech, ㅎ after ㄴ, ㄹ, or ㅇ gets very weak, so 은행 sounds like [으냉].

task.title: Hear and write ㅎ
task.line: Say each word out loud first. Then choose, write, or check the sound.

words.exampleMeaning: My older sister is getting married.
Are we watching a movie today?

letters.sound: ㅎ almost disappears; ㄴ slides into the next syllable.
ㅎ almost disappears; ㄹ moves over and sounds like a light r.
ㅎ fades to a soft breath or nothing; ㅇ stays.
At the start of a word, ㅎ stays clear and strong.

exercises: Choose the everyday sound: ① 문화 ([무놔] / [문나]) ② 일흔 ([일른] / [이른]) ③ 강해요 ([강애요] / [가내요])
Write the everyday sound in [ ]: ① 번호 ② 올해 ③ 간호사
Does the ㅎ get weak here? Write Yes or No: ① 허리 ② 만화 ③ 하나
Write the Korean spelling for each sound: ① [저놔해요] (I make a phone call.) ② [사랑애요] (I love you.) ③ [미아내요] (I'm sorry.)
answers: ① No ② Yes ③ No
① 전화해요 ② 사랑해요 ③ 미안해요
